statement: For a full sieve i:U→X of small categories and H_t=Hom_X(−,t)|U:U^op→Set, W-dwyérienne means every nonempty H_t is totally W-aspherical; totally W-dwyérienne means every nonempty U/t is totally W-aspherical; classical Dwyer additionally requires a right adjoint to U→bar(U). A W-cofibration is a functor whose cobase-change functor on undercategories preserves W.
depends_on: A:definitions; F_BataninBerger2017 Definition 1.1; F_Thomason1980 Definition 4.1; F_Cisinski1999 Definition 1
notes: The presheaf is contravariant; empty boundary weights are excluded from totality tests. Classical Dwyer and pseudo-Dwyer conditions are distinguished.

statement: For every fundamental localizer W, W-dwyérienne sieves and totally W-dwyérienne sieves are stable under arbitrary cobase change in Cat; every W-dwyérienne sieve is a W-cofibration. For any pushout of such a sieve along p:U→C, p∈W implies q∈W and i∈W implies i′∈W.
depends_on: A:elements-Kan; A:final-images; F:couniversal; relative Theorem A
notes: All categories are small; p is arbitrary, without fullness or object-injectivity assumptions. Uses only forward gluing, not full W(7) or W(7 bis).

statement: For every fundamental localizer W and every functor i of small categories, i is a couniversal W-equivalence iff i is both a W-cofibration and a member of W; W-cofibrations are closed under composition, cobase change, and arrow-category retracts.
depends_on: F:pushout; F_Thomason1980 Theorem 4.9; F_Cisinski1999 Proposition 2; F_BataninBerger2017 Lemma 1.10
notes: The general-W proof uses Thomason factorization and Cisinski’s corrected retract statement. The equivalence is not asserted for an arbitrary weakly saturated class lacking the localizer axioms.

statement: For a pushout of a W-dwyérienne sieve i:U→X along arbitrary p:U→C, full W(7 bis) implies i∈W iff i′∈W iff dot(T)→T belongs to W iff i is couniversally in W; full W(7) also implies p∈W iff q∈W. The first-to-last equivalence needs neither extra axiom.
depends_on: F:pushout; F:couniversal; full W(7 bis); full W(7)
notes: These are conditional reflection statements. Full W(7 bis) and W(7) must not be assumed for W∞; the boundary is dot(T)=bar(U)∩(X∖U).

statement: For W=W∞ or W=W_R with R a nonzero commutative unital ring, every connected component of a discrete opfibration over a totally W-aspherical category is totally W-aspherical; every nonempty full cosieve in such a category is total; and ∫_B D is total whenever B and every D(b) are total for a small covariant D:B→Cat.
depends_on: C:classification; C:inherit-elements; D:R-action; C:homology-A
notes: The Grothendieck construction uses actual transition functors. The variance is discrete opfibration; no corresponding assertion for arbitrary discrete fibrations is made. F:total-functor-general later strengthens the Grothendieck-construction clause to every fundamental localizer.

statement: Totally W-aspherical functors and totally W-dwyérienne full sieves are closed under composition for W=W∞ and for W=W_R with R any nonzero commutative unital ring.
depends_on: F:total-operations; A:final-images
notes: The composite comma category is a final image of a Grothendieck construction; for sieves its indexing category is a nonempty cosieve. F:total-functor-general strengthens functor composition to all fundamental localizers; sieve composition for all W is refuted at W₀ and W₁.

statement: For every fundamental localizer W, restriction f*:PSh(Y)→PSh(X) along a strictly W-aspherical functor f:X→Y preserves totally W-aspherical presheaves; consequently strictly W-aspherical functors are closed under composition.
depends_on: A:elements-Kan; relative Theorem A; collage and co-Yoneda formulas
notes: The proof works with a collage of Kan-extended restricted representables. It does not identify total presheaves with total categories of elements and does not by itself prove sieve composition.

statement: For every fundamental localizer W, totally W-aspherical functors of small categories are closed under composition. If B and every value of a small covariant diagram D:B→Cat are totally W-aspherical, then its Grothendieck construction ∫_B D is totally W-aspherical.
depends_on: F:strict-composition; E:forward-subterminal; A:final-images
notes: For total f and g, f_z:(gf)/z→Y/z has slices exactly X/y, so is total and hence strict. Pullback of the total terminal presheaf proves the composite total. For Grothendieck closure, the fibre inclusion D(b)→(∫D)/b is a right adjoint and ordinary final. This resolves total-functor composition for all fundamental localizers.

statement: For a fixed fundamental localizer W, total W-dwyérienne sieve composition holds iff every nonempty full cosieve of every totally W-aspherical small category is totally W-aspherical. For W_n with finite n≥2, total W_n-dwyérienne sieves compose whenever both inclusions are between finite categories (finitely many arrows).
depends_on: F:total-functor-general; F:total-composition; A:final-images; D:truncated-finite
notes: Necessity uses a lower copy of the cosieve followed by a terminal one-point extension, with a classical Dwyer first factor. Sufficiency applies the cosieve condition to the support in X/y and uses a Grothendieck construction. The finite-category clause does not assert the same conclusion for categories with only finitely many objects but infinitely many arrows.

statement: False composition assertion: W-dwyérienne full sieves, or totally W-dwyérienne full sieves, are closed under composition for W=W₀ and W=W₁; consequently the corresponding universal assertion for every fundamental localizer is false.
depends_on: D:zero-one; F:total-sieve-cosieves; E:forward-subterminal
notes: Each counterexample has a classical Dwyer first factor and a total second factor. The targets have six objects and respectively 15 and 21 arrows. The composite boundary is respectively a discrete pair and a parallel-arrow circle. Every arrow/composition, the right adjoint and triangle identities, the deformation, and the slice isomorphism are checked. Total-functor composition remains valid for all W.

statement: For every nonzero commutative unital ring R, every totally W_R-aspherical presheaf H:U^op→Set, and every full cosieve V⊂U, a nonempty restriction H|V is totally W_R-aspherical.
depends_on: A:elements-Kan; collage homotopy-pushout formula; suspension homology
notes: For each p:V→C the proof forces Σ² B(C/p_!(H|V)) to be R-acyclic. Nonemptiness then gives connectedness and R-acyclicity of the unsuspended element category; it does not establish its simple connectivity.

statement: For every nonzero commutative unital ring R, W_R-dwyérienne full sieves of small categories are closed under composition.
depends_on: F:cosieve-homology; F:strict-composition
notes: Restrict the second boundary weight to the cosieve generated by the first sieve, then apply strict-functor composition. The W∞ sieve assertion remains equivalent to the unresolved presheaf question in F:remaining-equivalence.

statement: A functor i:U→X is discretely flat iff disc(X) ⊔_{disc(U)} (−) preserves Dwyer–Kan equivalences of simplicial categories under disc(U); it is a discretely flat cofibration if also injective on objects, and a discretely flat inclusion if also faithful. Every full sieve satisfies the additional injectivity conditions.
depends_on: F_HORR2024 Definition 3.4
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035; comparison requested in Part F
notes: Here disc(A) has discrete simplicial mapping sets. This is the simplicial-category notion, distinct from W∞ h-cofibrations of ordinary categories.

statement: A full sieve i:U→X is discretely flat iff every boundary weight H_t⊗_U−:sSet^U→sSet preserves objectwise weak homotopy equivalences. Every totally W∞-dwyérienne sieve and every sieve with discrete source is discretely flat.
depends_on: F:DFdefinition; C:classification; simplicial collage pushout formula; co-Yoneda
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035; XII ms107–111; Part F class comparison
notes: The coend is computed degreewise. Necessity is tested with a simplicial collage having one new source; empty weights and an empty source are allowed.

statement: For every H:U^op→Set with E=U/H and π:E→U, H⊗_U− preserves objectwise simplicial weak equivalences iff every component of El_E(Lπ) is weakly contractible for every covariant L:U→Set. Among these weights, H is totally W∞-aspherical iff E is nonempty and connected; a discretely flat sieve is W∞-dwyérienne iff all nonempty U/t are connected.
depends_on: E:restricted-actions; F:weight-test; two-sided simplicial bar construction
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035,C045; XII ms111–114; Part F class comparison
notes: This is an exact restricted-action criterion. Total presheaf asphericity alone gives integral acyclicity of the action components; simple connectivity is the unresolved strengthening.

statement: For the one-object monoid category U with M={1,e}, e²=e, and the presheaf H={i,h₁,h₂} with H(e) constantly i, adjoining one object with crossing weight H gives a sieve that is W∞-dwyérienne and discretely flat but not totally W∞-dwyérienne.
depends_on: E:counterexample; E:idempotent; F:weight-test
notes: The weight is the pushout of two representables over a split subpresheaf. Its simplicial coend is V⊔im(d)V for an idempotent d, while the two maximal elements of U/H have no common successor. The row asserts the verified separating example.

statement: Every discretely flat full sieve is a W-cofibration for every fundamental localizer W; in particular it is an h-cofibration for W∞.
depends_on: F_HORR2024 Theorem 1.5 in generalized form; F:pushout
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035; XII ms110–111; Part F class comparison
notes: The published nerve-pushout theorem is the known input. The all-fundamental-localizer consequence is proved explicitly using homotopy-pushout invariance and W∞⊂W; it is not quoted as a separate theorem from HORR.

statement: False C035 assertion: every full sieve that is a W-cofibration, or even a couniversal W-equivalence, must be W-dwyérienne, for W=W∞, W=W_R with R a nonzero commutative unital ring, or W=W_n with n≥0.
depends_on: F:definitions; F:weight-test; explicit relative natural transformations
notes: The same 3-object, 7-arrow example a⇉t→s with equal composites is couniversal for every fundamental localizer, and discretely flat, but U/t is a discrete two-object category. This refutes the stated recognition implication even under couniversality.

statement: False C037/C038 assertions: a W-cofibration full sieve whose complementary full category is isomorphic to e (one object and only its identity) must be W-dwyérienne; more strongly, W-cofibration status after every change of complement T₁→T forces W-dwyérienness. Both fail for W∞, every nonzero commutative-unital-ring W_R, and every W_n with n≥0.
depends_on: F:weight-test; F:DFh; A:audit-homologygluing
notes: Take the sieve {a}→(a⇉t). Its source remains discrete after every complementary-category change, so all such sieves are discretely flat and W-cofibrations; the boundary is a discrete pair. Full W(7) does not save the statements because homology localizers satisfy it. This example is not couniversal for W∞ or nonzero homology; the precise couniversal variant is handled separately.

statement: For any small U and presheaf H:U^op→Set, let X be its collage with one new object t, crossing sets X(u,t)=H(u), no reverse arrows, and no nonidentity endomorphisms at t. The sieve U→X is couniversal W∞ iff H is totally W_Z-aspherical; for every nonzero commutative unital ring R, it is couniversal W_R iff H is totally W_R-aspherical.
depends_on: A:audit-cylinder; E:restricted-actions; categorical coverings; van Kampen; homological Whitehead theorem; Kan-extension transitivity
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035,C037; XII ms111; narrower couniversal one-point recognition question
notes: Relative homology proves necessity and the W_R equivalence, including exclusion of empty weights. For sufficiency at W∞, cyclic-subgroup local systems force π₁(C/F)→π₁(C) to be trivial for every total W_Z weight F; on universal covers, cone attachment then preserves homology and is a weak equivalence. One-point couniversal W∞ recognition is therefore equivalent to the unresolved total-W_Z-presheaf implication, while its homological analogue is proved.

statement: There exists a four-object full sieve U→X which is a couniversal W∞-equivalence but is not discretely flat; therefore discretely flat sieves form a proper subclass of W∞-cofibration sieves.
depends_on: F:weight-test; F:DFh; explicit relative natural transformations
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035; XII ms110–111; Part F class comparison
notes: The source is [1]. A pair of new arrows has equal precomposites, followed by a terminal object. The objectwise weak equivalence S¹→cone(S¹) versus S¹→point yields weighted coends S² and point.

statement: The sieve N→N^▷, with N in its usual order and a new terminal object adjoined, is totally W-dwyérienne for every fundamental localizer W but is not a classical Dwyer map.
depends_on: A:filtered; F:definitions
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: Lead 5; XII ms108–109; footnote on filtered examples
notes: The new boundary category is filtered N, but a right adjoint would select a greatest natural number. Combined with the other examples, this establishes strict class inclusions without assuming totality equals filteredness.

statement: False endpoint-stability assertion: for n≥2, the pushout-product of {0}→[1] with {0,2n}→Φ_n is a W-cofibration for W=W∞, or for a fundamental localizer W in which S² is not W-aspherical.
depends_on: F:couniversal; explicit collage/coend pushout computation
notes: The stated map is a weak equivalence between contractible categories. One cobase change sends an S² category to a contractible category, violating couniversality; another pushes out an actual weak equivalence and yields S³. The S² test is needed to include W₂. The proof covers every n≥2; n=2,3 are computed independently.

statement: For any fixed n≥2 and any fundamental localizer W with S² not W-aspherical, every class of full W-cofibration sieves closed under pushout-product with {0,2n}→Φ_n consists only of isomorphisms. Isomorphisms are the maximal C048 class for W∞, every nonzero commutative-unital-ring W_R, and W_m for m≥2.
depends_on: F:interval-failure; F:couniversal
notes: An inclusion with a crossing arrow retracts onto {0}→[1]; a nonisomorphic coproduct-summand inclusion acquires a crossing arrow after one endpoint product. Cobase-change closure is not needed for the impossibility.

statement: Every functor is a W₀-cofibration, and every object-injective functor is a W₁-cofibration. Consequently all full sieves form a class closed under cobase change and the required endpoint pushout-product for both W₀ and W₁.
depends_on: D:n-convention; F_HORR2024 proof of Theorem 1.6; π₀ and groupoid completion preserve pushouts
notes: The W₁ argument uses groupoid completion, which retains objects, and left properness of the folk model structure with object-injective cofibrations. These low truncations are exceptions to the S² obstruction.

statement: Universally over small bases and presheaves, five assertions are equivalent: every W∞-dwyérienne sieve is discretely flat; such sieves compose; every total W_Z-aspherical presheaf is total W∞-aspherical; nonempty full-cosieve restriction preserves total W∞-asphericity of presheaves; and every couniversal W∞-equivalence sieve whose complementary full category is isomorphic to e is W∞-dwyérienne. Any failure of composition can use a classical Dwyer first factor and a one-object-extension second factor.
depends_on: E:restricted-actions; F:DF-actions; F:weight-test; F:cosieve-homology; F:strict-composition; F:strict-sieve-homology; F:onepoint-couniversal
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035,C037,C045; XII ms111–114; Part E/F interface
notes: Only equivalence of the five assertions is proved; their common truth remains unresolved. The cone extension handles empty actions and infinite families; the converse uses component subpresheaves. The fifth assertion concerns a complement with one object and only its identity, not a complement merely possessing a terminal object. Couniversality forces the boundary weight to be nonempty.

statement: Unresolved: the five equivalent assertions of F:remaining-equivalence, including strict W∞ sieve composition and discrete flatness; for finite n≥2, strict W_n-dwyérienne sieve composition and total W_n-dwyérienne sieve composition without the finite-category hypothesis.
depends_on: F:remaining-equivalence; F:total-functor-general; F:total-sieve-cosieves; F:low-sieve-composition; F:strict-sieve-homology; F:C048-dichotomy
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: XIIba-C035,C037,C045; XII ms111–114; remaining truncation cases
notes: Strict and total functor composition is proved for all fundamental localizers. Universal strict/total sieve composition is refuted by finite W₀/W₁ examples; the fixed-W total-sieve criterion is exact. C048 is settled for every fundamental localizer in F_followup.tex. The W∞ presheaf obstruction, if it exists, has nontrivial perfect fundamental group; no such example is asserted.
